description: Every unifier \(\sigma\) of \((x\doteq t)::R\) also unifies \(R[t/x]\) and satisfies \(\sigma\star[t/x]=\sigma\) on all variables.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.TermUnification.elimination_factors.{u, v, w} {L : FirstOrder.Language} {α : Type w}
  (x : ℕ) (t : L.Term ℕ) (R : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.TermUnification.Problem L) (σ : ℕ → L.Term α)
  (hσ : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.TermUnification.Unifies σ ((FirstOrder.Language.var x, t) :: R)) :
  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.TermUnification.Unifies σ
      (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.TermUnification.substProblem
        (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.TermUnification.single x t) R) ∧
    Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.TermUnification.compose σ (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.TermUnification.single x t) = σ
